rules.name: Central blacklist gate
rules.summary: All CAF submissions must query the central blacklist before identity verification. Matches on tax ID, MSISDN, or national ID block progression to KYC.

rules.name: Minimum subscriber age
rules.summary: Legal applicant age floor is 18 years at submission date; derived from verified ID document date of birth only.

rules.name: ID uniqueness window
rules.summary: Same national ID may initiate at most one new CAF within a rolling 24-hour window (excludes correction flows linked to the same case ID).

rules.name: Contact number normalization
rules.summary: Mobile numbers normalized to E.164 after validation against region-specific MSISDN regex; rejects ambiguous trunk prefixes.

rules.name: National ID format
rules.summary: ID document numbers validated against configured national patterns before OCR payload is accepted into CRM.

rules.name: Mandatory face match
rules.summary: Critical flows (new SIM, broadband install, plan migration with hardware change) require live face match score ≥ vendor threshold; cannot be disabled per-template.

rules.name: Document authenticity scan
rules.summary: Government ID images trigger passive authenticity API; tamper or fraud signals route to manual review queue.

rules.name: Cross-document consistency
rules.summary: Name and DOB extracted from ID must align with subscriber profile within fuzzy tolerances before approval.

rules.name: Template change audit trail
rules.summary: Every publish or rollback of a CAF template writes an immutable audit entry (actor, diff hash, timestamp) retained per compliance policy.

rules.name: CAF document retention
rules.summary: Submitted CAF electronic records and attachments retained for seven years from closure date unless superseded by law.

rules.name: Rule registry versioning
rules.summary: Global rules carry semantic versions; breaking changes require CAB approval and staged rollout flag.
